scripts.guard:merge-surface: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const out=execSync('git diff upstream/main --name-only -- styles.css background.js utils.js').toString().trim();if(out){console.error('merge-surface guard FAILED, unexpected diff vs upstream/main:\n'+out);process.exit(1);}console.log('merge-surface guard: clean (styles.css, background.js, utils.js match upstream/main)');"
